description: Labeled routing scenarios against the bundled 1,000-skill corpus. `expected` is a list of acceptable resource-id substrings (the corpus contains duplicate capabilities, so several resources can be correct answers); a scenario is a hit when any of them matches. `style` classifies the task wording: `direct` shares vocabulary with the resource description, `paraphrase` rewords it with synonyms, `abstract` describes only the goal.
